title: On numerical issues of divergences between nearly equal distributions
abstract: arXiv:2611.18511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Barron et al. (2026) recently identified numerical issues in the softmax and soft cross-entropy loss. We show that similar issues are present in standard divergence operations between categorical distributions. This includes the forward and reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), as well as Monte Carlo KL estimates and entropy. When the distributions are nearly equal, rounding and cancellation issues affect the forward and gradient computations. These issues can affect settings using divergences in optimization objectives, such as knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, and proximal methods. We propose numerically stable reformulations and provide example implementations for each setting, validated by property-based tests.

translated_title: 关于几乎相等分布之间散度的数值问题
translated_abstract: Barron等人（2026年）最近发现了softmax和软交叉熵损失中的数值问题。我们证明在类别分布之间的标准散度运算中也存在类似的问题，这包括正向和反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度、广义Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），以及蒙特卡洛KL估计和熵。当分布几乎相等时，舍入和抵消问题会影响前向计算和梯度计算。这些问题可能影响在优化目标中使用散度的场景，例如知识蒸馏、强化学习和近端方法。我们提出了数值稳定的重新表述方案，并为每种情况提供了示例实现，并通过基于属性的测试进行了验证。
tldr: 该论文揭示了当类别分布几乎相等时，KL散度、JSD散度及熵等标准散度运算存在与softmax类似的数值精度问题，并提出了数值稳定的重新表述方案及经过属性测试验证的实现。
